lines.en: We have cough syrup and cough drops.

lines.en: The syrup is better at night. Drops are good in the day.

pages.title: A cough at night · 1/3
paragraphs: It is evening in Tampa and the air is warm. Eva coughs all day and cannot sleep well. She walks into a bright pharmacy near her home. The shelves are full of boxes and bottles. A friendly pharmacist named Hugo looks up. He smiles and waits for her question.
“Hello! How can I help you?” says Hugo. “I have a bad cough. What do you have for it?” says Eva. “We have cough syrup and cough drops.” says Hugo.
